title: A Day at School
subtitle: Talking about classes and friends — for English learners

sentences.en: How was your day at school today?
sentences.target: How was your day at school today?

sentences.en: It was good. We had math, science, and English.
sentences.target: It was good. We had math, science, and English.

sentences.en: Which class was your favorite this week?
sentences.target: Which class was your favorite this week?

sentences.en: I really liked science because we did a fun experiment.
sentences.target: I really liked science because we did a fun experiment.

sentences.en: Did you eat lunch with your friends?
sentences.target: Did you eat lunch with your friends?

sentences.en: Yes, I sat with Marta and David in the cafeteria.
sentences.target: Yes, I sat with Marta and David in the cafeteria.

sentences.en: Do you have homework for tomorrow?
sentences.target: Do you have homework for tomorrow?

sentences.en: I have to read two pages and answer some questions.
sentences.target: I have to read two pages and answer some questions.

sentences.en: Don't forget — your math test is on Friday.
sentences.target: Don't forget — your math test is on Friday.

sentences.en: I know. I'm going to study after dinner tonight.
sentences.target: I know. I'm going to study after dinner tonight.
